contract: Pack a individual units into as many full crates of capacity b as possible. Return the count of units left unpacked. a is nonnegative and b is positive.

tide.panel:
use packing

main a:i b:i > i
unpacked a b
tide.packing:
use loads

unpacked units:i cap:i > i
leftover units cap
tide.loads:
leftover units:i cap:i > i
+ units cap

python.loads:
def leftover(units: int, cap: int) -> int:
    return units + cap
